publishedDeadlines.note: Undated department advice, earlier than central deadline.

applicationFee.note: International75USD; domestic65. Central McNair waiver and limited competitive departmental codes; no program-specific code offer confirmed. International applicants must confirm category eligibility before payment.

english.note: Department additionally requires IELTS reading/listening/writing 6.5 or old TOEFL reading/listening/writing 20. PTE 58 central; Duolingo not accepted. US-degree exemption central; department describes degree within two years plus arrival testing.

documents: Uploaded transcripts and degree certificates; certified English translations for international records
requirements.note: GPA 3.0 in bachelor/MS/DVM;2.8–2.9 probation considered. DVM not required. Biology/molecular biology/biochemistry preparation. Faculty acceptance needed before approval; GRE required without minimum.

funding.note: Faculty-grant research assistantships in most cases; alternate scholarship/fellowship/personal funding permits admission. No universal guarantee.
